event_definition: All-E10ms rate: a peak>=20Hz, duration<=300ms, bounded on both sides by at least30ms continuously<5Hz. Events not already returned before first onset are excluded from preentry count. These are model events, not labels of patient TA/TB.

rows.name: add_g0.25_s9108401

temporal_audit.interpretation: Read-only temporal audit of the original state marker. High is the unchanged all-E >=200Hz for200ms; strict quiet is all-E and both cores <5Hz for at least30ms. Rolling low-window confirmation may overlap a new burst; inspect actual intervals and finite events before accepting a recurrence figure.

rows.readiness_rule: At least3 finite preentry events, operational high-return-high and at least2 finite events during the return interval. This is a review aid, not a biological success threshold or proof of patient compatibility, an autonomous attractor, or independent confirmation.
rows.confirmation: One development noise realization unless the job explicitly names a separate seed. Human raster and native-field review still required.
